verses.text: In my distress I cried unto Jehovah, And he answered me.

segments.text: In my distress I cried unto Jehovah,

verses.text: Deliver my soul, O Jehovah, from lying lips, And from a deceitful tongue.

segments.text: Deliver my soul, O Jehovah, from lying lips,

verses.text: What shall be given unto thee, and what shall be done more unto thee, Thou deceitful tongue?

segments.text: What shall be given unto thee, and what shall be done more unto thee,

verses.text: Sharp arrows of the mighty, With coals of juniper.
Woe is me, that I sojourn in Meshech, That I dwell among the tents of Kedar!

segments.text: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Meshech,
That I dwell among the tents of Kedar!

verses.text: My soul hath long had her dwelling With him that hateth peace.

segments.text: My soul hath long had her dwelling

verses.text: I am for peace: But when I speak, they are for war.

segments.text: But when I speak, they are for war.
